column4: rdf.test.ts: IRIs parsed or refused, namespaces, literals and their tags, triples and quads; type-level tests that an individual of one class is not another's
rdf.test.ts: the eight vocabularies give the IRIs of their specifications, and a vocabulary is made from local names
rdf.test.ts: an individual's values typed from its schema, its triples in the schema's order, and type-level tests of a missing field, a wrong range and a wrong class
rdf.test.ts: the OWL schemas, a code list and its union, a SKOS scheme and its notations
rdf.test.ts: a non-integer, a word not of its list, a subject stated twice and a bad namespace are named
rdf.test.ts: the writers' output for known statements, escapes, and the same bytes for random orders of the same statements (fast-check)
rdf.test.ts: the package exports no reader
the package is built, inspected and packed by tools/pack.ts; tests/commons-packages.test.ts installs the tarball and runs it on Node 26 and Bun and type-checks a consumer
